component.name: Dannify
component.summary: Search, play and keep songs with artwork, tags and synced lyrics

description.p: Dannify searches YouTube Music, plays it, and keeps the songs you save in your library to play offline, with artwork, tags and synced lyrics.
Your library is organised by song, artist, album and playlist, with a listening history and stats, and listens can go on to ListenBrainz.
